caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally on a plain background. The chair is rendered in shades of gray and blue, suggesting the use of ink and wash or graphite, with no other colors present. The chair has a broad, curved top rail that features carved floral decorations, and a narrower horizontal back splat with ornate designs. Vertical spindles connect the seat to the backrest. The seat is rectangular with slightly beveled edges. The legs are turned and feature carved details, connected by horizontal stretchers for support. The background is a solid, light beige color without any additional objects or details, and a faint rectangular border frames the chair. The artist's signature "W. W. Jennings" appears at the bottom right within the bordered area.
title: Chair
